findings.summary: the scene backend still constructed its upload batch inside the frame loop, releasing the persistent transfer buffer this very branch added at the end of every frame — only the sprite runner had the run-lifetime hoist; the declaration moved above the while, mirroring the sprite runner

seventeen caller-side mutable-counter lambdas re-derived a slot index the three stage walks already own, six of them near-identical shadow-fallback closures; the walks now hand the resolver the slot, and one with_shadow_uniform_rows helper serves every family
SDL's new node-material texture arm repeated the whole find-or-create-and-refcount shell of the shader arm beside it where Dawn had folded the two; SDL now takes Dawn's one-arm shape with a fill fork

refresh_shadow_generators called the emitted gate in four copy-pasted family arms and kept the per-frame verdict in a parallel vector beside the gates; one gate call with an optional CSM key, one verdict write, the verdict as a lane on ShadowRefreshGate, and fitted_shadow_casters hoisted once

the emitted gate computed the per-caster version sum and the caller built the CSM camera key before consulting force_refresh_every_frame; the flag now short-circuits at the top — the pin's own evaluation order — and the key builds only when it is off

on gated frames the refresh walk still packed, compared and copied every generator's receiver block though the skipped fit proves the bytes unchanged; the pack is skipped when not due and already uploaded
the frame-graph TUs kept hand-rolled post_process_program find-or-create walks and numeric_limits sentinels beside the very helpers this branch created; both adopted npos and find_or_create_program
the three sprite upload functions defaulted a nullable batch and kept a one-shot fallback arm no caller reaches; the parameter is a reference and the arm is deleted

the dual-stem alsoStages mechanism was applied only to post-process while effect and both node families still deployed identical bytes under two stems; effect converted directly, node needed a two-line Dawn edit first (its loader read each stem's own file) and then converted — 30 more duplicate vertex-stem files gone across 26 node scenes, with per-stem compiled artifacts proven byte-identical, and the keep-alive moved to the generic composition write so the next declarer cannot forget it
hoistEngineContinuation emitted the defer_start_continuation wrapper in two places; the outer hoist now folds as part zero's wrap, proven byte-neutral over the corpus

a post-mark frame yield inside a helper body silently kept the erasure the branch had just made truthful for entry bodies; it now refuses with the same message, proven non-vacuous by an A/B fixture that compiled silently before

verify-corpus hand-rolled a concurrency pool beside runConcurrently and restated the fetch-outcome triage in three arms with drifting wording; runConcurrently adopted, one classified fetch serves all arms, the archive verdict flattened, the summary distinguishes digest-verified rows from provenance-only generated rows, and an output-less generatedBy row refuses

the shadow gate contract anchored the ESM and CSM factory defaults but not the two PCF factories whose emitted gate runs with the flag permanently false, and quoted the caster-array identity rule without asserting it; both anchors added
the alsoStages expansion in compile-shaders.ps1 scanned all declared modules per source with reflection probes; the synthetic rows group into a hashtable once per directory

the emitted light-key comment overstated itself (spot angle and range are fit inputs); rewritten to the real parity argument — the pin's worldMatrixVersion key is equally insensitive to both, so both sides go stale identically

stale text left by the branch's own changes: the moved bind_stage_storage doc pointing at a deleted shared walk, two Dawn 'two deployed files carry the same text' comments, the architecture and features pages' deploys-twice claims for post-process and effect modules
tint-reflection sidecars replayed from the shader cache embed the absolute path of whichever scene first compiled the shared variant, so generated-tree digests churn with compile order
findings.blockedBy: pre-existing shader-cache behavior, not introduced by this branch; the fix (rewrite the requesting path on replay, or strip at record time) is its own change to the cache contract with its own replay proof
